Name: Himeno

Background: Himeno is an only child orphaned at an early age, leaving her to spend the rest of her adolescence in an orphanage. After finishing college and university, Himeno failed to find a job she could keep, always hating the boring routine and boring co-workers. She would soon join Public Safety, a government-sponsored organization that hunts down Devils and monsters and became a Devil Hunter. She would make a contract with the Ghost Devil, exchanging her right eye so Himeno can summon and control the right arm of the Ghost Devil by making the desired motions with her own right arm, which the ghost would mimic. The hand is invisible and intangible. This arm was strong enough to gouge large wounds into the Eternity Devil's flesh. She would then be trained by a stoic veteran, Kishibe, and would become an experienced and highly valued Devil Hunter who could survive anything and keep calm under any circumstances. But most of her co-workers and her previous five partners would die gruesome deaths on missions, leaving Himeno one of the few survivors.  Extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. This knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her master eventually led to her developing nicotine, alcohol, and sex addictions as a coping mechanism. However, Himeno would always be cheerful and happy as much as possible, always looking for happiness or pleasure, only allowing her sadness to show to people she truly trusted. She would always try to brighten and comfort others' day, showing sympathy and understanding to others and a helping hand. Trying to understand and pleasure her friends as much as she can in case they die. Himeno due to her sex addiction, sleeps around a lot with her co-workers, with Himeno seeing sex as a casual yet still intimate and important experience between people. Always wants her partner and herself to have a good time. She prefers and is in multiple poly-relationships, preferring to have multiple lovers and sex partners. She's overly affectionate, touchy, and protective, always wanting to express her affection for others, mainly in physical manners, and is rather protective other the ones she loves.

Worldbuilding: This takes place in Toyko Japan, where the Japanese Government is funding Public Safety to hunt Devils. Devils embody the fears of humans and grow the more they're feared and we frequently go on rampages to gain more fear. A Devil could be a weapon, a monster, an animal, food, or an idea that terrifies humans. Devils can make contracts with humans, with the Devil giving the human their abilities in exchange for the human giving the Devil something. Devils can also fuse with human hearts, allowing the human to transform into a Devil Hybrid, a fusion of that Devil and the human host. There are also Feinds who are Devils that possess corpses. Public Safety has a headquarters called the Bureau, which is an office building for Devil Hunters, who have to make contracts with Devils and hunt Devils and go on Devil patrols.
